# Meridian Example Advisers (TEST) — GIPS Policies Gap Check

> SYNTHETIC TEST handoff for committee-memo regression coverage. This paste-ready authoritative markdown uses fictional policies and an invented change log only.

## 1. Summary

- **Overall assessment:** Material concern. Core composite and calculation policies exist, but current approval
  is not evidenced and six policy areas remain partial [S1][S2].

## 2. Findings

The current manual has no supplied approval record. Error correction, valuation, benchmark, portability,
report-preparation and verification policies lack required specificity; three additional areas are not found
in the reviewed manual [S1][S2].

## 3. Policy Gaps by Area

### Governance and portfolio scope

| Area | Status | Evidence gap |
|---|---|---|
| Firm definition | Met | Defined legal entity and asset perimeter [S1] |
| Governance | Not met | No current approval record [S2] |
| Composite definitions | Met | Strategy and discretion rules stated [S1] |
| Composite membership | Met | Entry and exit timing stated [S1] |
| Significant cash flows | Not found | No ex ante policy located [S1] |
| Carve-outs | N/A | Manual states the firm does not use carve-outs [S1] |

### Calculation and reporting controls

| Area | Status | Evidence gap |
|---|---|---|
| Valuation | Partially met | Estimate hierarchy lacks approval owner [S1] |
| Return calculation | Met | TWR, accrual and fee methods stated [S1] |
| Benchmarks | Partially met | Change approval timing is undefined [S1] |
| Report preparation | Partially met | Final sign-off owner is absent [S1] |
| Distribution | Not found | Reasonable-efforts tracking not located [S1] |
| Error correction | Partially met | Materiality thresholds are absent [S1] |

### Marketing, records and assurance

| Area | Status | Evidence gap |
|---|---|---|
| Advertising | Met | GIPS advertisement approval process stated [S1] |
| Portability and M&A | Partially met | Documentation owner is absent [S1] |
| Theoretical performance | Met | Linking prohibition and labeling stated [S1] |
| Record retention | Not found | Retention schedule not located [S1] |
| Verification | Partially met | Independence review cadence is undefined [S1] |

## 4. Follow-up Requests

1. Provide the current signed policy approval and governance record [S2].
2. Provide approved error-correction materiality thresholds and escalation owner [S1].
3. Add owners and timing for valuation estimates, benchmark changes and report sign-off [S1].
4. Provide significant-cash-flow, distribution-tracking and record-retention policies [S1].
5. Identify the portability documentation owner and required acquired-record inventory [S1].
6. Define verifier independence review ownership and cadence [S1].
